main_idea: On-policy distillation lifts GDPval net win-loss margin about +21% across two model families.
ideas: On-policy distillation improves student performance on GDPval
Gains hold across two model families
Paired comparisons show wins, ties and losses versus base
Student learns from its own generations via teacher feedback
summary: Clutter: method flow, rubric and win-rate side panels, and repeated footer and takeaway lines compete with the two net-margin stats; the logo nearly disappears. Nothing needed is missing.
defects: AfterQuery logo mark is near-white and nearly invisible on the cream background
Subtitle wraps leaving single-word orphan 'GDPval.' on its own line
